uscourts_court_finder_autocomplete.publisher: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (uscourts.gov)
uscourts_court_finder_autocomplete.notes: The JSON list behind the court finder's search box (970 suggestions in 7 groups, including 380 courthouse building names). Names only: no addresses, cities or districts. The finder's result pages (/federal-court-finder/find), which hold the addresses, answer HTTP 403 (Akamai 'Access Denied') to this pipeline, so no addresses could be taken from it.
